description: Truncate text to at most N tokens (cl100k_base: ~4 chars/token) to avoid exceeding an LLM context window. Optionally keeps the end of the text instead of the start (useful for keeping recent conversation history). Reports whether truncation occurred and the estimated token count.

from_end.description: Keep the end of the text instead of the start (default: false)

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to keep

name: truncate_to_tokens
